title: Rectangular bar
spec: Start by setting up a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees for all axes and a translation vector also set to zero. Next, create a new face and draw the first two-dimensional sketch. This sketch consists of a rectangular loop made up of four lines. The first line starts at the origin (0.0, 0.0) and extends horizontally to (0.075, 0.0). The second line continues vertically from (0.075, 0.0) to (0.075, 0.75). The third line moves back horizontally from (0.075, 0.75) to (0.0, 0.75), and the fourth line completes the loop by returning to the origin. After drawing the rectangle, apply a scale factor of 0.75 to the entire sketch to reduce its size proportionally. Ensure that the sketch remains aligned with the original coordinate system by rotating it with Euler angles set to zero and translating it with a vector of zero. To transform this scaled two-dimensional sketch into a three-dimensional object, extrude the sketch 0.025 units along the normal direction without extruding in the opposite direction. Finally, integrate the extruded sketch into a new solid body. The resulting rectangular bar will have a length of 0.075 units, a width of 0.75 units, and a height of 0.025 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(0.075, 0).lineTo(0.075, 0.75).lineTo(0, 0.75).close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = sketch.extrude(0.025)

# Display the result
